[SWS_CRYPT_00909]
{DRAFT}
Update
⌈
The user application shall be able to call
Up-
date
multiple times, each time providing a new chunk of data.
Update
shall update the
hash value calculation with each new chunk.
Update
shall return a
CryptoError-
Domain::kProcessingNotStarted
error, if
Start
has not been called before.
⌋
